notes: Every timing phase was measured without cProfile or tracemalloc; stage shares and metadata memory use separate passes.
The reference revision captures through prepare() with an empty partition; canonical capture and normalization are reported separately for comparable scope.
RSS includes the Python interpreter, tensors and allocator caches. Metadata tracemalloc bytes are not tensor allocator totals.
No CUDA or cross-device transfer was executed. Cache hit rate is since the last explicit cache clear.
